questions.question: Dr Ramdan is passing on his practice to his son, Dr Youssef. According to Article 25, how is the lease transferred?
options: By simple donation between close relatives
By assignment of the lease with notification to the landlord
By a mandatory notarial deed
By a declaration to the prefecture
questions.explanation: Art. 25: the transfer is carried out by assignment of the lease, with notification to the landlord for enforceability.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wishes to transfer his business to his partner. According to Article 7, how is the transfer valued?
options: On the purchase value of the equipment
On the tax declarations of the last 4 financial years
On the valuation of an independent expert
On the rental value of the premises
questions.explanation: Art. 7, para. 3: the value of the business is estimated on the basis of the tax declarations of the last four financial years.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan obtained an eviction judgment but the landlord is not paying. According to Article 28, what procedure should be followed?
options: Request seizure of the landlord's assets
Remain in place until payment is made
Request forced execution from the judge
All of these procedures are possible
questions.explanation: Art. 28: several procedures are available: seizure, forced execution, remaining in the premises.

questions.question: Dr Kamali needs to form a team of lawyers to manage his assets. According to Law 49-16, what is the advantage of early transfer?
options: Avoid inheritance conflicts
Allow transfer with full knowledge
Optimize the taxation of the transfer
All of these advantages are relevant
questions.explanation: Early transfer makes it possible to avoid conflicts, optimize taxation and prepare the succession smoothly.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord included a non-competition clause in the lease. According to case law, is this clause valid?
options: Yes, if it is geographically and temporally limited
No, it is contrary to freedom of enterprise
Yes, unless it is disproportionate
No, non-competition clauses are prohibited
questions.explanation: Non-competition clauses are valid if they are limited in space and time.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wishes to transfer his practice to multiple buyers. According to Article 24, is subletting authorized?
options: Yes, unless otherwise stipulated in the lease
No, subletting is prohibited by default
Yes, but only with the landlord's consent
No, the lease is personal to the tenant
questions.explanation: Art. 24, para. 1: the tenant may sublet all or part of the premises, unless otherwise stipulated.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan received a buyout offer for his business. According to Article 7, how is the eviction compensation calculated?
options: On the value of the business, works and moving costs
On the sole value of the business
On moving costs only
On the value of the dental equipment
questions.explanation: Art. 7, para. 3: the compensation includes the value of the business, works expenses and moving costs.

questions.question: Dr Kamali needs to draft a will concerning his practice. According to inheritance law, what is the advantage of a will?
options: Organize the transfer according to his wishes
Avoid conflicts between heirs
Designate the buyers of the practice
All of these advantages are relevant
questions.explanation: The will makes it possible to organize the transfer, avoid conflicts and designate the buyers.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan faced an eviction procedure. According to Article 26, how can the lease end?
options: Only by expiration of the lease
By expiration, termination, annulment or renunciation
Only by court decision
By agreement of both parties only
questions.explanation: Art. 26: the lease may end by expiration, termination, annulment or renunciation.

questions.question: Dr Kamali was appointed as a court-appointed expert. According to Law 49-16, what is the expert's responsibility?
options: Objectively evaluate the assets
Produce a report compliant with the law
Be impartial and independent
All of these responsibilities are required
questions.explanation: The expert must evaluate objectively, produce a compliant report and be impartial.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan must pass on his expertise to his successor. According to Law 49-16, what is the impact on the lease?
options: No impact, the lease is autonomous
The successor benefits from the right to renewal
The successor must sign a new lease
The landlord may refuse the transfer
questions.explanation: The successor benefits from the rights attached to the lease, including the right to renewal.

questions.question: Dr Kamali filed a complaint against his landlord. According to Article 28, how is the eviction executed?
options: After the deposit of the compensation by the landlord
After a period of 3 months following the judgment
After the expiry of the appeal period
All of these elements determine the execution
questions.explanation: Execution is conditional on the deposit of compensation, the 3-month period and the expiry of appeal deadlines.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan benefited from a judicial settlement. According to Law 49-16, does this settlement have the authority of res judicata?
options: Yes, if it is approved by the court
No, the settlement does not have res judicata authority
Yes, automatically
No, it must be confirmed by a new judgment
questions.explanation: The settlement approved by the court has the authority of res judicata.

questions.question: Dr Kamali was evicted but the landlord did not rebuild. According to Article 11, what are the consequences?
options: The landlord must pay additional compensation
The tenant may return to the premises
The landlord loses his demolition rights
All of these consequences are possible
questions.explanation: Art. 11: failure to comply with deadlines may result in additional compensation, reinstatement or loss of rights.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan faced a neighbor dispute. According to Law 49-16, is the landlord's liability engaged?
options: Yes, for disturbance of enjoyment
No, it is a private conflict between tenants
Yes, only if he was informed
No, unless there are specific clauses
questions.explanation: The landlord may be held liable for disturbances of enjoyment caused by other tenants.

questions.question: Dr Kamali hired an architect for works. According to Article 3, is the tenant's liability engaged?
options: Yes, for damage caused to the premises
No, only the architect is responsible
Yes, but only if the works are poorly executed
No, the landlord is responsible for the works
questions.explanation: Art. 3: the tenant is responsible for damage caused to the premises, even by his employees.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan received a takeover offer from a large group. According to Law 49-16, what are the tenant's rights?
options: The right to assign his lease
The right to sublet
The right to renewal
All of these rights are guaranteed
questions.explanation: Law 49-16 guarantees the rights of assignment, subletting and lease renewal.

questions.question: Dr Kamali challenged a notice in court. According to Article 26, can the court order damages?
options: Yes, in case of abusive notice
No, only legal costs are awarded
Yes, but only if the tenant requests them
No, the law does not provide for damages
questions.explanation: The court may award damages in case of abusive notice, to compensate for the loss suffered.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan is ending his career and transferring his practice. According to Law 49-16, what is the last advice to give to the buyer?
options: Strictly comply with the lease clauses
Maintain good relations with the landlord
Be attentive to deadlines and formalities
All of these pieces of advice are essential
questions.explanation: The three elements are essential for a successful transfer: compliance with clauses, good relations, vigilance on formalities.

questions.question: Dr Kamali successfully completed all the certification tests. According to Law 49-16, what is the conclusion of this training?
options: Mastery of Law 49-16 is acquired
The tenant can now manage his lease with full peace of mind
The protection of the tenant's rights is ensured
All of these conclusions are valid
questions.explanation: The training allows mastery of Law 49-16, managing the lease with peace of mind and ensuring the protection of rights.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan successfully transferred his practice according to the rules. According to Law 49-16, what is the secret to this success?
options: Good knowledge of the law
Peaceful relations with the landlord
Anticipation of difficulties
All of these elements are key
questions.explanation: Success is based on knowledge of the law, good relations and anticipation of difficulties.

questions.question: Dr Kamali trained his successor in Law 49-16. According to the training, what is the central pillar of this law?
options: The protection of the right to renewal
The protection of the right to eviction compensation
The protection of tenant rights in general
All of these pillars are central
questions.explanation: Law 49-16 protects the right to renewal, the right to compensation and tenant rights in general.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan wrote a practical guide to Law 49-16. According to this guide, what is the main message to remember?
options: Knowing your rights is essential
Prevention is better than litigation
Legal support is recommended
All of these messages are essential
questions.explanation: The guide teaches that knowledge of rights, prevention and legal support are essential.

questions.question: Dr Kamali obtained his certification in commercial lease law. According to Law 49-16, what does this certification mean?
options: Complete mastery of Law 49-16
The ability to manage all aspects of a commercial lease
The competence to advise other dentists
All of these meanings are valid
questions.explanation: The certification attests to mastery of the law, management ability and competence to advise.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan concludes this training as an expert. According to Law 49-16, what is the final word for future dentists?
options: Law 49-16 is a shield for your practice
Knowledge is your best weapon
Prevention is your best ally
All of these pieces of advice are worth remembering
questions.explanation: The law is a shield, knowledge is a weapon and prevention is an ally: all three are essential.
